messages.author: 403be63af7ebf220
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] error when constructing unmarkedFrameOccu
parts:
Hi Patrick,

You need to supply the "siteCovs" argument with a data.frame. Instead, you are giving it a factor. This should fix it:

siteCovs <- cat[,c("camera"),drop=FALSE]

or this:

siteCovs <- data.frame(camera=cat$camera)

Richard
